title: A dedicated, synthesised Rotor spin loop; Isao's voice written down
context: Owner: add a dedicated rotor spin loop sample. And a note on Isao's personality: stoic builder, no complaining just building, upbeat techno-optimist, protopian, wise beyond his looks; a loss is 'Oh no! They destroyed my RADAR!' (angry) then 'Oh well. Rebuild.'
outcome: scripts/synth-rotor-loop.mjs synthesises assets/audio/rotor_spin.wav: one second, 44.1 kHz mono PCM16, a four-blade chop at 48 Hz with harmonics over a 110 Hz motor hum, every partial an integer number of cycles per loop, filtered air noise crossfaded over the seam. Attached to the Rotor's minigun_ready cue as its loopFile (the beam sustain's pattern: one key, the mp3 played once, the WAV bed looped), so the package needs no new key; pinned as a derived asset in docs/rotor-audio.lock.json keyed to the generator's hash. The Rotor's spool loops it with pitch 0.5 at rest to 1.0 flat out. Isao's voice is recorded at the top of src/isaobriefs.js and in docs/STORY.md, and the study line now ends with what he does next: build more compute. A first cut registered a new package key and found the authoring tool cannot promote one (it loads the live package on start and the validator refuses either side alone); the loopFile shape avoids the question.
alternatives: A recorded sample from the owner's set: none exists for a rotary spin; the synthesis is one script and can be replaced by a recording under the same key.
evidence: node scripts/assets.mjs: derived assets verified including docs/rotor-audio.lock.json
npm test, npm run check, browser --story-world before commit
